checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Preserves all seven seconds of original footage without changes
must.why: No video was delivered; only a standalone audio link and editing instructions.

must.item: Tense instrumental bed audible, no singing
must.why: A 15 s wav exists (has sound), but the mood and lack of vocals cannot be verified. It is not 7 s and is not in the clip.

must.item: Original radio calls remain present and synced including 'Rook, you with me?'
must.why: No combined output exists, so nothing is mixed or synced with the clip.

must.item: Music perceptibly below voice during every spoken line
must.why: No mix was made; the user is told to duck manually.

must.item: Music audible but subordinate, not muted
must.why: There is no mix to judge; the track is standalone.

faults.what: No video output delivered; the core request (music mixed under the original clip) was not fulfilled, only a separate 15 s audio file and manual instructions.
The audio is 15 s rather than the 7 s clip length and peaks at -1 dB, so it is loud and needs trimming and ducking by the user.

summary: The agent supplied only a separate 15 s music track and manual mixing instructions, not the clip with music under the radio calls, so the request was not delivered.
